single_turn_cases.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees receive?
single_turn_cases.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave plus UK public holidays.

single_turn_cases.question: How many days each week should hybrid employees normally attend an office?
single_turn_cases.reference_answer: Hybrid employees normally attend an office at least two days each week.

single_turn_cases.question: How much unused annual leave can be carried forward and when must it be used?
single_turn_cases.reference_answer: Up to five days can be carried forward with manager approval and must be used by 31 March.
